name: retirebridge
description: Guided retirement scenario intake and local model previews with a plan-file handoff to Rest of the Road.

interface.longDescription: Answer five core intake steps, run the same educational scenario models used by Rest of the Road, and export a local plan file for review and detailed exploration on the website. Models run on your machine; information typed in Codex follows Codex data handling. Requires Node.js 24 or newer.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a retirement bridge scenario.
Open my RetireBridge plan and test a change.
Run my plan and help me review the assumptions.
